label: Zyxel XGS2220-30F
description: Zyxel XGS2220-30F - fibre access variant: 24x 1G SFP (ports 1-24) instead of copper, 2x 1G/2.5G/5G/10G RJ-45 (25-26) and 4x 1G/10G SFP+ (27-30). 168 Gbps, 125 Mpps, no PoE.

fabric.note: Vendor switching capacity of 168 Gbps, the full-duplex aggregate of the port rates (24 x 1G + 2 x 10G + 4 x 10G = 84 Gbps each way).

notes: This model has no 10/100/1000BASE-T access ports at all - the datasheet 10M/100M/1G RJ-45 row is a dash - so all 24 access ports are 1G SFP cages and the only copper is the two multi-gig uplinks. The 30-port total is the same 24 + 2 + 4 layout the PoE table confirms for the copper models, and the SFP slots are numbered 1-24 on that basis. Switching capacity 168 Gbps is the full-duplex aggregate of the port rates (24 x 1G + 2 x 10G + 4 x 10G = 84 Gbps each way), so it caps nothing the ports cannot already do and is recorded as a fabric figure rather than a limit. Forwarding rate 125 Mpps, 2 MB packet buffer, 32 K MAC addresses, 9 K jumbo frames, 64 static routes, 32 IP interfaces, 4 K VLANs, 64 MB flash and 1 GB RAM. No PoE anywhere on this model, which is the practical difference from the -30HP: it aggregates powered edge switches but cannot itself be the PSE for anything. Physical stacking is a datasheet feature rather than a modelled one: the English datasheet says a stack is built through the last two or four 10-Gigabit fibre ports, up to four units in a ring, while the specification table in the same document still lists physical stacking as being in a future firmware release - recorded here because two pages of one datasheet disagree about whether the shipped firmware already carries it. The console port is USB Type-C rather than RJ-45, and the User Guide (https://download.zyxel.com/XGS2220-54FP/user_guide/XGS2220-54FP-UG.pdf) describes that connector as troubleshooting-only until the Access L3 licence is activated, after which it carries the CLI. Any serial-console assumption about this box is wrong twice over: the connector, and the condition. 1RU, 441 x 270 x 44 mm, single fixed AC input (100-240 V AC), smart fan. Sources: datasheet https://www.zyxel.kr/support/datasheet/XGS2220_Series.pdf and the product page https://www.zyxel.com/global/en/products/switch/xgs2220-series/specifications.
